free_tier.stated: Per-asset caps only, no aggregate quota: 20 MB for most asset types; Video up to 3.75 GB each, up to 20 video uploads/day for ID-verified 13+ accounts (5 min duration, 4096x2160 max). Audio: 100 uploads/month if ID-verified, 10/month if not.

retention.stated: 20 MB/asset for models, images, decals, animation; video 3.75 GB but capped at 20/day and 5 min; audio hard-capped monthly; all uploads land in moderation; assets are permanently tied to a creator account.

egress.terms: Free. Asset delivery is served by Roblox's own CDN (assetdelivery.roblox.com / rbxcdn), never metered to the uploader.

record.tooling: Documented Open Cloud REST: POST https://apis.roblox.com/assets/v1/assets (multipart, x-api-key header), plus asset delivery API. API keys scoped to a user or group; no rclone.
record.chaining: 20 videos/day x 3.75 GB = 75 GB/day per ID-verified account = ~2.2 TB/month; unlimited accounts (each needing ID verification) and unlimited assets per account since there is no total quota. Non-video types: 20 MB x unlimited assets x 100-upload monthly audio cap.
record.limits_note: 20 MB/asset for models, images, decals, animation; video 3.75 GB but capped at 20/day and 5 min; audio hard-capped monthly; all uploads land in moderation; assets are permanently tied to a creator account.
record.reliability_note: Moderation removes assets silently and irreversibly; read-back needs an authenticated assetdelivery call (anonymous GET -> 401), so it is not a public cacheable fetch path.
